records.name: Alzheimer's Association Delaware Valley Chapter: Caregiver Support Groups
records.summary: Free groups for unpaid family members and friends who care for someone with Alzheimer's or another dementia. Trained facilitators lead them by phone, video or in person.
records.what_you_do: Talk through the hard parts of caregiving, get practical tips, and hear from others in a similar spot. The chapter also runs early-stage groups for people with a diagnosis, and some groups are tailored to younger-onset needs.

schedule.text: Meeting times vary by group and change, so check the group finder or call the helpline before you go.

first_step.how: Call the 24/7 helpline at 800.272.3900 to find a group near you and confirm its next date.
first_step.basis: Open to any unpaid caregiver, with a phone line and a group finder to join.

records.notes: Chapter page lists no dated groups. The group finder it links (alz.org/event-search) is dynamic and was not read. The page describes the chapter as covering Delaware and southeastern Pennsylvania. The 800 number is the 24/7 helpline shown on the page.

records.name: Survivors of Suicide Loss Support Group
records.summary: Free, confidential groups for adults grieving a loss to suicide. Trained facilitators who are suicide loss survivors lead the meetings.
records.what_you_do: Share your loss in a small group, listen to others, and learn how people carry grief over time. Come to whichever meeting fits your week.

schedule.text: Three online meetings each month: second Wednesday at 7 to 8 pm, third Thursday at 2 to 3 pm, and fourth Tuesday at 7 to 8 pm. A phone dial-in is offered.

first_step.how: Join by Zoom or the phone dial-in for any meeting. No pre-registration is needed. You can email the organizer to say you plan to come.
first_step.basis: Open to any adult grieving a suicide loss, with no sign-up and a published way to join.

records.notes: The group page names the organizer as the Healthy Minds Philly initiative of the city's Department of Behavioral Health and Intellectual disAbility Services. 267-831-0333 is the meeting dial-in line shown on the group page, not a general office line. The Nov 24 (fourth Tuesday) meeting appears on the calendar only.

records.name: Parent and Caregiver Support Group
records.summary: Free online group for parents and caregivers of people with mental health, behavioral health or substance use challenges. A licensed therapist leads it.
records.what_you_do: Talk with other parents and caregivers, share what has helped, and get support from a licensed therapist who leads the group.

schedule.text: First Thursday of each month, 6 to 7 pm Eastern, on Zoom. Next session: Nov 5, 2026.

first_step.how: Join using the Zoom link on the event page. No sign-up is described.
first_step.basis: Open to parents and caregivers, with no sign-up described and a link to join.

records.notes: The event page names Mental Health Partnerships as organizer. Its own site returned 403 and was not read. The page says the group is for ages 14 and over but does not say whether that means the parent or the person they support, so min_age is left blank. The Oct 1, 2026 session was also listed.

records.name: Sibling, Family and Lone One Support
records.summary: Free online group for adult siblings, other family members and partners of adults with mental health, behavioral health or substance use challenges. A licensed clinical therapist leads it.
records.what_you_do: Share what it is like to love someone who is struggling, and learn from others in the same spot.

schedule.text: Second Thursday of each month, 6 to 7 pm Eastern, on Zoom. Next session: Nov 12, 2026.

first_step.how: Join the Zoom link on the event page. No sign-up is described.
first_step.basis: Open to family and partners of adults with these challenges, with a link to join and no sign-up described.

records.notes: The event page names Mental Health Partnerships as organizer. Listed on the calendar for Oct 8 and Nov 12, 2026.

records.name: Caregiver Support Group: Navigating Neurodiversity (Virtual)
records.summary: Online peer group for caregivers of neurodivergent children, listed through Healthy Minds Philly. The listing does not state a cost.
records.what_you_do: Share the day to day side of raising a neurodivergent child and trade what has worked with other caregivers.

schedule.text: Dates seen on the calendar: Oct 6, Nov 3 and Dec 1, 2026, 8 to 9 pm Eastern, on Zoom.

first_step.how: Register through the Zoom registration link on the event page to get the meeting link.
first_step.basis: Open to caregivers, with a clear registration link on the event page.

records.notes: The listing names no organizer beyond Healthy Minds Philly and gives no phone or email. The Oct 6 and Dec 1 dates come from the calendar pages.

records.name: Parents Support Group (Philly HEALs)
records.summary: Free online group for parents whose child died from a drug-related loss. The city's Philly HEALs program runs it.
records.what_you_do: Share your loss with other parents, talk about what helps you get through the days, and hear from people who understand.

schedule.text: Online sessions, 6:30 to 8 pm Eastern, on Zoom. Listed dates: Oct 7 and Oct 21, Nov 4 and Nov 18, and Dec 2, 2026. The event page itself names Nov 4.

first_step.how: Sign up with the city's online form to get the Zoom link.
first_step.basis: Open to parents with this kind of loss, with a clear sign-up form and no screening described.

records.notes: The 215-516-9429 number is the organizer phone shown on the Healthy Minds event pages. The city program page lists no phone. The event page lists Nov 4 only; the calendars list the other dates.

records.name: Sibling Support Group (Philly HEALs)
records.summary: Free online group for people whose sibling died from a drug-related loss. The city's Philly HEALs program runs it.
records.what_you_do: Talk with other siblings about your loss, the people you miss, and how you keep going day to day.

schedule.text: Online session on Thursday, Nov 12, 2026, 6:30 to 8 pm Eastern, on Zoom. The calendar also listed Oct 8, 2026. No other dates are shown.

first_step.how: Sign up with the city's online form to get the Zoom link.
first_step.basis: Open to people grieving a sibling this way, with a clear sign-up form.

records.notes: Phone is the organizer phone shown on the Healthy Minds event page. Whether this session recurs is not shown.

records.name: Virtual Grief Support Group: All Arms Locked
records.summary: Free online group for men grieving a loss that carries stigma, such as overdose, addiction, homicide or suicide. Philly HEALs runs it.
records.what_you_do: Meet other men with similar losses, build a circle of people who understand, and learn ways to cope with grief.

schedule.text: Mondays, 6 to 7 pm Eastern, online. Listed dates: Oct 5, 12, 19 and 26, and Nov 2, 9 and 16, 2026.

first_step.how: Sign up through the city's online form to get the link.
first_step.basis: Open to men with a loss of this kind, with a clear sign-up form.

records.notes: The event page names Nov 2 only; the calendars list the other dates. The page does not name a video platform. It gives an individual staff email, which is not recorded.

records.name: Philly HEALs Grief Support Groups
records.summary: The City of Philadelphia's bereavement program for people grieving a loss linked to substance use. It runs free online peer groups.
records.what_you_do: Pick the group that fits your loss. The city page names a drop-in group, a parents group, Hot Widows' Club, GRANDS, a Spanish-language group (Hay Otros en Duelo), and Writing Grief. The program also offers grief counseling for adults and youth, and workshops.

schedule.text: The city page does not list meeting days or times for each group. Use the city sign-up form to ask about the group that fits, or check the Healthy Minds Philly calendar for current dates.

cost.text: Free for the groups listed on the calendar

first_step.how: Use the city's online sign-up form, linked from the program page, to ask about a group.
first_step.basis: Open to people grieving a substance-related loss, with a sign-up form as the way in.

records.notes: The city page gives no audience, schedule or cost for the six named groups. Dated listings for the parents, sibling and All Arms Locked groups come from the Healthy Minds calendar. The city page lists no phone; 215-516-9429 is from the Healthy Minds event pages. A 2022 city announcement described six-week cycles; it was not used for current status.

records.name: Mothers In Charge Grief Support Group
records.summary: Group and one-on-one grief support for people who have lost a loved one to violence in Philadelphia. Mothers In Charge, Inc. runs it.
records.what_you_do: Join the Monday noon group, or ask for one-on-one support on Thursdays as needed. The organization also offers crisis counseling and a support hotline.

schedule.text: VOCA group sessions on Mondays at 12 pm. One-on-one sessions on Thursdays as needed. The site says group support is available weekly.

first_step.how: Call 215-228-1718 to join a group or ask for one-on-one support.
first_step.basis: The site gives a phone number to call to join, and no sign-up form.

records.notes: The group schedule on the site is undated. The 2026 dates on the site belong to other events: a Sept 5, 2026 community breakfast and an Oct 20, 2026 Tea and Coffee session. The Hearts of Gold group is named in a news post and is listed under leads_only. The anger management program is court referred and is not a support group, so it is not recorded.

records.name: Tea and Coffee: Welcoming New Members
records.summary: A monthly coffee and chat for families newly bereaved in the Mothers In Charge community. It is a gentle first step for new members.
records.what_you_do: Have a cup, talk with other families in the early months after a loss, and learn what the organization offers.

schedule.text: Every first Tuesday of the month. The site does not print a time for the monthly gathering. A special session ran Tuesday, Oct 20, 2026, from 11:30 am to 1:30 pm.

first_step.how: Call 215-228-1718 or email info@mothersincharge.org to ask about the next gathering.
first_step.basis: Built for newly bereaved families, and the site says how to ask to attend.

records.notes: Address conflict on the site: the text says Suite 301 and the footer map link says Suite 703. Suite 301 is recorded. The monthly schedule line prints no year; 2026 comes from the single-event Oct 20 flyer.

notes: Lane U, mental health, grief and caregiver. WebSearch: 3 of 3 used (hard cap reached). WebFetch: about 42 used. 11 publish records. Main gaps: hospice bereavement groups open to the public were not searched (search budget ran out), so none are recorded. Other survivor groups beyond Mothers In Charge and Healthy Minds Philly were not found. Not recorded: Uplift Center for Grieving Children (site suspended, details seen only in a search summary); NAMI Philadelphia (403); Mental Health Partnerships' own site (403); GriefShare listings (403); Philadelphia Corporation for Aging (no reachable site); Compassionate Friends (its national pages name no Philadelphia chapter, and the chapter locator is a search form that lists none). Women Against Abuse: the homepage lists services but no support groups, so it is dropped; its sub-pages were not checked. St. Luke's caregiver flyers (2024 and 2025) returned 404. Not recorded as groups: Grief Walk in Nature (Nov 21, 2026, one-time event), Grief and Loss Workshop (Oct 29 and Nov 26, 2026, educational), Moving Through Loss Grief Workshop (Oct 21, 2026, educational), Out of the Darkness Community Walk (Oct 10, 2026, fundraiser). Alzheimer's Association early-stage groups need prescreening through the helpline; they are described in the chapter record. The Philly HEALs group list on the city page has no schedules, so the dated groups come from the Healthy Minds calendar. Every phone number and email here is as printed on an organization's page or a Healthy Minds event page; personal names and personal emails were left out.
